originalTitle: CRISPR-Cas13 RNA Editing System Corrects Metabolic Mutation in Preclinical Models
originalContent: Gene therapy researchers have achieved highly selective transient RNA editing without making permanent genomic alterations. Using a engineered Cas13 variant delivered via lipid nanoparticles, the team successfully restored hepatic enzyme function in animal models of hereditary tyrosinemia. Biologists highlight the potential for treating acute genetic disorders safely.
